claims.text: Valbenazine, a vesicular monoamine transporter-2 inhibitor, is approved for tardive dyskinesia; it needs hepatic function monitoring during initiation.
claims.quote: Valbenazine a vesicular monoamine transporter-2 inhibitor, has been approved for treatment of tardive dyskinesia but requires hepatic function monitoring during initiation.

claims.text: Most important adverse effects: hypersensitivity, somnolence, QT prolongation and parkinsonism.
claims.quote: The most important adverse effects are hypersensitivity, somnolence, QT prolongation, and parkinsonism.

claims.text: Deutetrabenazine, another VMAT2 inhibitor, is also approved for tardive dyskinesia.
claims.quote: Deutetrabenazine, another vesicular monoamine transporter-2 inhibitor, is also approved for the treatment of tardive dyskinesia
